text: sir package implements Social Influence Regression model Minhas & Hoff (2025) directed relational data observed time. explains network influence – lagged, model-implied channels one actor’s past behavior predicts another’s future behavior – using observable covariates, via bilinear (low-rank) regression. linear predictor a_ik = sum_r alpha_r W_r[,k] b_jl = sum_r beta_r W_r[j,l] express sender/receiver influence matrices B influence covariates W. Equivalently eta = theta^T z + (X_t B^T)_{ij}, mu = g^{-1}(eta). SIR estimates conditional temporal association unless design justifies causal interpretation. Treat “influence” model term unless temporal ordering, exogeneity W/Z, unmeasured confounding, lag construction, proposed intervention defensible substantive question. main inputs play distinct roles:
